summary: This note is a wiki-style article about "Unbreakable", the debut single by English musician James Cottriall, taken from his first studio album "Sincerely Me". The song was released as a digital download in Austria on 9 April 2010, written by Cottriall and produced by Alexander Kahr. It charted on the Austrian Singles Chart, reached number 1 on the Ö3 Hörercharts, and was included on two compilation albums.
one_line: Debut single by English musician James Cottriall, released in Austria in 2010, which topped Austria's Ö3 Hörercharts.
key_facts: "Unbreakable" is the debut single by English musician James Cottriall.
"Unbreakable" is taken from James Cottriall's first studio album "Sincerely Me".
"Unbreakable" was released in Austria as a digital download on 9 April 2010.
"Unbreakable" received massive support from almost every local and national Austrian radio station.
"Unbreakable" entered the Austrian Singles Chart at number 47.
"Unbreakable" peaked at number 16 on the Austrian Singles Chart.
"Unbreakable" reached number 1 in the Ö3 Hörercharts (Most Requested Charts for Austria).
"Unbreakable" remained in the Top 40 Charts for 20 weeks.
"Unbreakable" was featured on the compilation album Ö3 Greatest Hits vol. 50.
"Unbreakable" was featured on the compilation album AustroPop Forever Vol. 4.
